    Media releases

    This section contains all current Media releases on topics and news items concerning AUDI AG.

    • 10/09/2026
      Audi Media Center

      30 years of the Audi A3: three decades of ‘Vorsprung’ in the premium compact segment

      Audi is celebrating 30 years of the A3. Since its world premiere at the 1996 Salon Mondial de l’Automobile in Paris, the Audi A3 has become one of the brand’s most iconic and successful model series. As the vehicle that established the premium compact class, it has kept generations on the move for decades now. To date, more than six million units of this compact model have rolled off the assembly line.
    • 10/07/2026
      Motorsport

      Grand stage for the Audi RS 5 at the Formula 1 race in Singapore

      This coming weekend (October 9–11), Audi will compete in a Formula 1 night race for the first time. As part of the Singapore Grand Prix, the new Audi RS 5 will also have a grand stage to mark its market launch in overseas markets – featuring a special design that captures the unique atmosphere of the Asian metropolis.
    • 10/02/2026
      Audi Media Center

      Intelligent. Integrated. Instantly available. quattro ultra in the Audi A6 allroad

      The Audi A6 allroad offers versatility, comfort, and confident handling thanks to an intelligently controlled all-wheel-drive system. The quattro with ultra technology is used in the A6 allroad V6 TDI and the A6 allroad e-hybrid, making the benefits of all-wheel drive permanently available while also being optimized for efficiency. The new Audi A6 allroad* is now available at Audi dealerships, starting at €77,250 for the six-cylinder diesel and €80,250 for the plug-in hybrid.
    • 09/11/2026
      Company

      Audi begins production of the A2 e-tron: greater speed, efficiency, and competitiveness

      Audi has begun production of the A2 e-tron in Ingolstadt. The first units of the new electric model rolled off the assembly line in the presence of Bavarian Minister-President Markus Söder. With production of the A2 e-tron, Audi is demonstrating how the company is becoming more efficient itself: development time has been shortened by 21 months, the range of variants and complexity have been significantly reduced, and the degree of automation has been increased. Existing equipment and production facilities continue to be used.
    • 09/08/2026
      Models

      Audi CEO Gernot Döllner: “A2 e-tron makes e-mobility easier, more efficient and more convincing for everyday life”

      Ingolstadt/Paris, September 8, 2026 – Audi CEO Gernot Döllner unveiled the Audi A2 e-tron in Paris. With its focus on efficiency, intelligent technology, and everyday usability, the all-electric compact model is a tangible example of Audi’s renewal. The Audi A2 e-tron is specifically tailored to the needs of European customers.
    • 09/07/2026
      audi.com

      Audi A2 e-tron: Rethinking efficiency

      The Audi A2 e-tron puts efficiency at the center of attention. With energy consumption of 12.8 kWh/100 km according to WLTP, it consumes less energy than any other series-production model from the brand before it. In the interior, the vehicle combines versatility with new digital services and is deliberately tailored to the needs of European customers. Developed in Germany and built in Ingolstadt, the A2 e-tron demonstrates how Audi is becoming more efficient itself: the new electric model was developed significantly faster and intelligently makes continued use of existing production structures. Order books open in fall 2026, with the first deliveries beginning in December.
    • 09/02/2026
      Company

      Martin Sander to take over Sales and Marketing at Audi

      Ingolstadt, September 2, 2026 – The Volkswagen Group and AUDI AG are filling two key Board of Management positions: Martin Sander, currently Member of the Board of Management for Sales, Marketing and After Sales at the Volkswagen brand, is returning to Audi and will take over the Board of Management responsibility for Sales and Marketing effective October 1, 2026. Marco Schubert will become a member of the Extended Executive Committee of the Volkswagen Group for the North American region. In this new function, he will assume responsibility for the overall management of the North America region and report directly to Oliver Blume, CEO of Volkswagen Group.
    • 08/25/2026
      Models

      Audi Nuvolari debuts in the U.S.

      Monterey, U.S., August 25, 2026 — Just 17 days after the world premiere of the Audi Q9 in New York City, the Audi Nuvolari made its North American debut at Monterey Car Week. Its appearance at one of the world’s most exclusive automotive events underscores the U.S. market’s strategic importance for Audi. During the event, the Nuvolari, limited to 499 units, also made its road debut on California’s scenic coastal roads.
    • 08/21/2026
      Motorsport

      Innovation against microplastics: URBANFILTER at the Formula 1 race in Zandvoort

      Since September 2020, the Audi Environmental Foundation has supported the development of smart filters for street drains together with scientists from the Technical University of Berlin and other partners. At the Dutch Grand Prix of Formula 1 in Zandvoort, the Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile (FIA) will deploy the URBANFILTER concept for the first time in top-level motorsport.
    • 08/06/2026
      Models

      The Audi Nuvolari in 405 days

      405 days from the first sketch to the drivable prototype: the Audi Nuvolari demonstrates a new pace in vehicle development at Audi. The making-of video traces the project’s journey from the initial concept ideas through development and testing to the endurance tests with the drivers of the Audi Revolut F1 Team and the world premiere in the South of France.
